description: Set the hourly charge-out rate on a labour card: role, currency, hourly_minor in whole MINOR units and the day it starts. The same role, currency and date REPLACES that row rather than adding one. Free.

currency.description: ISO code this rate is in. Defaults to the shared business profile's currency

hourly_minor.description: The hourly rate in whole minor units. 8500 is EUR 85.00 an hour. Never a decimal

role.description: The role charged for, e.g. senior developer. Lower case, this is what an hours line is priced from

sku.description: A catalogue code this role bills under, so a resolved hours line carries the SKU's name and VAT rate

valid_from.description: The first day this rate applies, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today

name: rate_set
title: Set a labour rate
